svg.title: One clock tick carries 6 bits, 16 ticks carry two pixels
svg.desc: Each column is one clock tick with one bit on each of the six data pins R1, G1, B1, R2, G2, B2. Sixteen ticks, from bit 15 (MSB) to bit 0 (LSB), transfer one complete pixel of the primary row and one of the paired row.
svg.text: How one pixel pair travels over the six data pins
Each cell is one bit. The number in the cell is the bit index of the 16-bit colour value.
One clock tick = one column (outlined): 6 bits at the same time, one on each data pin.
16 ticks = one pixel pair: 16 bits per colour component for the primary row and for the paired row, MSB first.
